response.sql: WITH filtered_ab AS (SELECT "abhvreg", "translink" FROM "advancedbehavior" WHERE "peercorr" >= 0.149), matched AS (SELECT fab."translink", tr."ordertypedist" FROM filtered_ab fab INNER JOIN "transactionrecord" tr ON fab."translink" = tr."transreg" WHERE tr."ordertypedist" IS NOT NULL), counted AS (SELECT "translink", "ordertypedist", COUNT(*) as cnt FROM matched GROUP BY "translink", "ordertypedist"), totals AS (SELECT "ordertypedist", SUM(cnt) as total_cnt FROM counted GROUP BY "ordertypedist") SELECT c."translink", c."ordertypedist", c.cnt as "count", CAST(c.cnt AS FLOAT) / t.total_cnt as fraction FROM counted c JOIN totals t ON c."ordertypedist" = t."ordertypedist" ORDER BY fraction DESC LIMIT 10;
